limits_and_interpretation: Generated first-party fixtures only. No universal grouping or authoring accuracy claim; a flat source can produce the same supporting surfaces as original groups.
The corpus field source_grouping_known indicates whether source func_groups existed. The flat-ambiguous case is known to have none; inferred assemblies remain explicitly unproven.
Disconnected assemblies without shared surfaces can remain flat, and order constraints can reject otherwise supported proposals.
Groups copy recognized recovered worldspawn settings. Original lost group parameters/names are not recovered; three controlled lighting comparisons do not prove arbitrary re-bake equivalence.
Geometry/material/content/order and sampled spatial partition/PVS agreement are required independently of successful compilation. Finite sampling is not universal visibility proof.

Fast sloped MAP output changes intentionally. The controlled stored planes now rebuild exactly across six dominant-axis/sign orientations; original editor coordinates and texture mappings are not recovered by fast mode.

Work, brush and side limits plus world/surface ownership/context controls are tested. Existing detail tests exercise the report ceiling; a group-only saturation of the 64 MiB ceiling is not part of this corpus.
ASan/UBSan run with the established legacy process-lifetime leak exclusion. Release and sanitizer tests overlap in time; their durations are validation timings, not performance benchmarks.
Broader group/light inference, saved overrides and workbench proposal review remain open. The portable 0.3.0 archive is unchanged.
